title: Arrays
description: Write methods that take and return arrays.

checkpoints.title: Array average
checkpoints.description: average(values) returns the mean as a double.

checkpoints.title: Double every element
checkpoints.description: doubleAll(values) returns a new array without mutating the input.

checkpoints.title: Array contains
checkpoints.description: contains(values, target) searches the array for a value.

checkpoints.title: Sort an array
checkpoints.description: sort(values) returns a new ascending-sorted array without mutating the input.

checkpoints.title: Fibonacci sequence
checkpoints.description: fibonacci(n) builds the first n Fibonacci numbers into a new array.
